source_board_geometry.batching: Concatenated primitives per native node/material; no simplification or geometry alteration.
source_board_geometry.visible_geometry: Native board outline, cutouts/holes, outer tracks/pads, silkscreen and soldermask. Historical zone fills and inner copper not exported; native files retain them.

public_component_geometry.body_xy_basis: Saved native Fab graphics excluding text, otherwise courtyard/body envelope. No supplier model geometry.
public_component_geometry.display_height_policy: Nominal display assumptions; inspect individual records for inherited source notes.

coordinates.mapping: PCB X -> GLB X; PCB Y -> GLB Z; GLB Y is upward; F bodies positiveY, B bodies negativeY
coordinates.origin: Native default KiCad origin; no centering or normalization applied

credits.source: Direct LDO Carrier native project and project authors
credits.scope: 80 independently authored nominal component previews; engineering citations remain on the schematic.

qualification: 80 independently authored nominal bodies from saved footprint drawings. Display heights are assumptions; no assembled-fit or hardware qualification.
manufacturer_part_number_policy: Case-insensitive alphanumeric field keys: manufacturerpn > mpn > manufacturerpartnumber > mfrpn > mfrpartnumber. Internal PARTNUMBER codes, Current_manufacturer_part_number annotations and Value are excluded.
